cohort_role: development; excluded from neural weight training but used for model development and calibration
mr_exclusion_evidence: Author confirmation, 2026-10-06: both patients were excluded throughout density-network training.
calibration: unchanged release v1.0.0 commissioning files; no fitting or scale sweep
segments: all segments in each patient's released training plan
batching: Reset the released per-invocation cone cache every 12 segments; reuse the same density volume and unchanged model. Accumulate all output frames.
plan_weights: unit weights, not clinical optimization weights
prediction_path: unmodified released runtime; collect float32 output frames after cutoff before serialization
plan_mae: high >=80%, mid [30%,80%), low [10%,30%) of reference plan maximum; normalized by that maximum

r80.exclude: undefined reference or prediction R80, or no reference falloff below 50% after peak
r80.reference: unthresholded MC; separate original range-scoring analysis

timing: synchronized dose prediction only on a shared GPU; exploratory, not a publication runtime benchmark; excludes density, loading, metric computation and serialization
cutoff_application: predicted and reference segment dose <= cutoff is zeroed before unit-weight plan summation
selection: All complete original release-output plans; no diagnostic preprocessing variant or refitted calibration selected
comparison_scope: Thresholded release-output maps, not the unthresholded physical dose field or hidden leaderboard
